evidence: On TensorFlow 2.14.1 and KerasCV 0.6.4, fitting RetinaNet on a batch with zero ground-truth boxes triggers InvalidArgumentError at retina_net_label_encoder/GatherV2_1: indices[0,10000] = 0 is not in [0, 0).
steps: Created a dense zero-box dataset with shape [2, 0, 4] for boxes and [2, 0] for classes.
Built keras_cv.models.RetinaNet with a no-download ResNet50 backbone preset.
Called model.fit for one step and observed the GatherV2 out-of-range failure in RetinaNetLabelEncoder.
